summary: Largo Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer listed on TSX/NASDAQ, closed a US$5.7 million registered direct offering of 10,200,000 common shares plus accompanying warrants at US$0.56 per unit; warrants strike US$0.70, immediately exercisable, expiring five years from issuance. H.C. Wainwright acted as exclusive placement agent. Insiders ARC Fund IV and Co-CEO Jim Bannantine bought 2,499,999 units on identical terms, a related-party transaction relying on MI 61-101 exemptions. Proceeds fund working capital and trade creditors. Watch dilution, warrant overhang, possible further financings, and management's alignment signal.
